 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
This petition under Article 226 of Constitution of India has been filed seeking following reliefs:
"(i) Issue a writ in the nature of mandamus against the respondents to pay the enhancement compensation/award with interest immediately, in the interest of justice.

(ii) Any other relief which the Hon'ble Court deems fit may also be granted to the petitioner, in the interest of justice."
2.

It is the case of petitioner that award dated 26.02.2021 was passed by First Additional District Judge, Panna in MJC No.23/2019 and the Reference under Section 18 of Land Acquisition Act was allowed and additional amount with interest was awarded.

The petitioner has filed an execution,
which is pending for the last approximately two years with no substantive progress and therefore, it is prayed that respondents may be directed to pay the compensation amount by complying with the award dated 26.02.2021.
3.
Heard the learned counsel for petitioner.

sentences.text: 4. It is very easy to obtain a decree but it is very difficult to execute the same.
However, it is really surprising that where the defendant is the State Government, still the petitioner is not in a position to get the award executed at the earliest.

5. Under these circumstances, this Court is of considered opinion that an exceptional circumstance has been pointed out by the petitioner seeking a direction to the Executing Court to execute the award as early as possible for the reason that on one hand the petitioner has been deprived of his property by respondents by acquiring the same and on the other hand, the respondents are not ready and willing to pay the enhanced compensation amount awarded by the reference Court.
6. Furthermore, the counsel for petitioner as well as the respondents also pointed out the fact that SLP which was filed by the State against the impugned award has also been dismissed.
7. Accordingly, the Executing Court is directed to expedite the hearing of execution proceedings.
8. From the proceedings of the Executing Court, it appears that the Executing Court is issuing warrant to District Collector, Panna but no report is being sent back by the Collector Panna.
Therefore, Collector, Panna is directed to appear personally before the Executing Court on 23.08.2024 and shall file his response to the recovery warrant.

In case, if the Collector, Panna fails to appear before the Executing Court on 23.08.2024, then the Executing Court shall be free to issue a warrant of arrest (non-bailable) against Collector, Panna for his appearance on a date, which shall be fixed by the Executing Court.
9. With aforesaid observation, the petition is finally disposed of.
10. The petitioner is directed to submit a copy of this order before the Executing Court, Panna for necessary information and compliance.

(G.S. AHLUWALIA) JUDGE SR* Date: 2024.08.13 18:06:52 +05'30'
